description.short: Ecommerce conversion, checkout, error and experiment insights from Noibu
description.full: Connect Noibu to Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork to work from your store's session, error and conversion data. Check the store's health, analyze checkout, products and traffic segments, diagnose errors and slow pages, find and build A/B tests, and run accessibility audits. Reports appear as a card in the chat, followed by clickable next steps. Every write, send or schedule needs your confirmation; each user signs in to Noibu individually and sees only the stores their Noibu account can access.

agentConnectors.description: Noibu ecommerce analytics: session, page-visit, conversion and revenue data, error diagnosis, A/B tests, Shopify theme changes and accessibility audits for Noibu-monitored stores.
